GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Rdr reported from the outside barrier he was unable to obtain a position with cover and, as a consequence, the gelding was obliged to race very wide and without cover throughout the event, and this was the principal reason for it failing to close off in the home straight. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.
